title: Could Homework Widen the Gap Between Families?
paragraphs: Many children take homework home. Some parents have a lot of time. Other parents are very busy.
Scientists in Manchester wrote about this. They looked at one mother and one teacher. The mother works until 8 in the evening.
The scientists say homework can be unfair. Some families have more time and money. Some families do not. Schools should think about this.

questions.q: What does the mother do until 8 in the evening?
What can homework be, say the scientists?
